author: richburdon
principle: Source an environment-specific value (like a service URL) from config with a code-level default, rather than hardcoding a constant, matching how sibling values are already configured.
fix_shape: read the value from config with a fallback default instead of a hardcoded constant

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When encoding a well-known data type in an interchange format, follow an established spec/convention rather than inventing a new ad hoc one.
fix_shape: adopt the existing spec's marker/format instead of a custom one

author: richburdon
principle: Before adding a new plugin/mechanism, check whether an existing plugin already covers the same concern and could be extended instead.
fix_shape: fold the new capability into the existing plugin rather than adding a parallel one

author: richburdon
principle: Import from a package's barrel/index path rather than reaching into an internal file path.
fix_shape: import from `../components` instead of the deeper internal path

author: richburdon
principle: A non-trivial exported module or class should carry a short comment describing its purpose.

author: richburdon
principle: Do not wrap a value in useMemo when it adds no benefit, such as memoizing state that is already stable on its own.
fix_shape: drop the redundant useMemo and use the state value directly

author: richburdon

fix_shape: replace `// --- Section ---` style comments with a plain `// Section.` sentence

author: dmaretskyi

author: dmaretskyi
